editorial:
Imagine losing your parents in a freak car crash and then finding out your house isn't empty. That is exactly what happens to Sarah and Kevin. Sarah is completely broken by the loss and starts seeing a scary woman lurking in the corners of their home. She is sure this woman killed their parents, while Kevin is just trying to keep things together. The vibe is super tense from the start, making you wonder if there is a real ghost or if Sarah is just losing her grip on reality. It feels like a slow burn that eventually turns into a full-blown nightmare.

The acting is top-notch, especially the lead actress who makes you feel her panic. The plot twists are genuine surprises, though some parts of the middle feel a bit slow. If you love psychological scares that mess with your head, you will love this one.
endingExplained: You find out that the creepy woman was actually a hallucination caused by Sarah's grief and a hidden mental break. The big twist is that Sarah actually caused the car accident that killed her parents. In the final scene, she tries to hurt Kevin because she thinks he is part of the ghost's plan. Kevin manages to save her, but the movie ends with Sarah staring into a mirror and seeing the woman one last time.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves psychological thrillers and ghost stories with a twist.
